facts.name: Solomon's Seal
facts.notes: Graceful arching stems hung with creamy bells in late spring, then blue-black berries. Tough in dry shade and spreads slowly into a colony.
facts.toxSrc: The blue-black berries are poisonous (general references; not on the ASPCA list)

companions.why: Combines well with bleeding hearts, ferns, lungworts, bergenia, wild ginger, astilbes and hostas.
